clusters.pattern: Model marks minimal acknowledgments (e.g., 'Dạ') as làm_dịu despite lack of genuine empathy or understanding, especially after customer objections or price comparisons.
clusters.mechanism: Rules rely on presence of polite or acknowledgment keywords without assessing whether the response conveys empathy or addresses customer concerns; lacks detection of superficial or perfunctory replies.

clusters.pattern: Model fails to recognize positive telesales attempts to reassure or add value (làm_hài_lòng) when phrased as product benefits or incentives, resulting in false negatives.
clusters.mechanism: Rules insufficiently capture promotional or reassuring language as làm_hài_lòng, especially when phrased indirectly or embedded in sales pitch rather than explicit satisfaction statements.
